evidence.note: Entry closet door is closed and the user's hand is on its handle.
Closet door is open, exposing hanging clothes and shoes.
User grasps the open closet door to close it.
Closet door is fully closed.
User reaches for the over-range microwave handle.
Microwave door has swung open.
User pushes the open microwave door closed.
Microwave door is fully closed.
User pulls the oven handle and the door begins opening.
Oven door is open with the illuminated interior visible.
Oven door is still partially open and moving upward.
Oven door is closed under the user's hand.
User reaches toward the dishwasher handle.
Dishwasher door is fully open, exposing its racks.
Dishwasher remains partly open immediately before closing.
User pushes the dishwasher door shut.
Dishwasher is fully closed.
User reaches to the pair of upper cabinet fronts above the sink.
One cabinet door is visibly swung outward.
The cabinet remains open with both door panels visible.
Cabinet fronts are closed as the user's hand withdraws.

events.object_description: Left door of the double upper cabinet above the sink

evidence.note: Opening begins at the center seam of the double cabinet.
The second cabinet door is open, revealing shelves and stored items.
Both cabinet doors remain open.
Both cabinet fronts appear closed.

events.object_description: Right door of the double upper cabinet above the sink

evidence.note: User pulls the upper drawer beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is open with food-wrap boxes visible.
Drawer remains extended.
Drawer is fully closed.
User pulls the refrigerator's upper-door handle.
Upper refrigerator door is open and interior light is on.
Upper refrigerator door remains open.
User swings the refrigerator door closed.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.
User pulls the lower freezer handle.
Lower freezer door is open, revealing drawers.
User is pushing the open freezer door closed.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.
Laundry closet door is closed just before opening.
Door is open, revealing stacked washer and dryer.
User grasps the laundry closet door to close it.
Laundry closet door is fully closed.

notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. The two independently hinged upper-cabinet panels are reported separately as required, although their individual manipulation instants fall within the same sparsely sampled interval.
scene_description: A person moves through a studio apartment and sequentially opens and closes an entry closet, microwave, oven, dishwasher, upper kitchen cabinet doors, a drawer, refrigerator and freezer compartments, and a laundry closet.
